title: Reason in Style: Discovering and Controlling Style in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively

translated_title: 以风格推理：发现并控制语言模型中的风格
translated_abstract: 语言模型将内容与风格联合学习，导致其输出中的风格变化难以识别和控制。我们研究了能否在无监督的情况下发现模型回复中反复出现的风格，并对其进行显式控制。我们设计了一种算法，学习将语言模型输出中的内容表示与风格表示分离，并在受控环境下通过数学问题验证了其有效性。通过将该方法应用于来自九个不同教师模型的超过10万条经过验证的推理轨迹，我们发现了六种反复出现但分布不均衡的风格。随后，我们微调较小的学生模型，使其在显式条件化于这些风格时能够遵循相应风格，并使用重要性加权来平衡语料库中各风格的贡献。该方法在六个数学推理基准上均比在相同数据上进行的标准微调取得了更高的Pass@k，证明我们能够有效地多样化答案的风格。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无监督算法将语言模型输出中的内容与风格表示分离，发现了六种反复出现的数学推理风格，并通过重要性加权微调使学生模型显式遵循这些风格，从而在六个数学推理基准上超越了标准微调的Pass@k性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an unsupervised algorithm to disentangle content and style representations in language model outputs, discovers six recurring math reasoning styles, and fine-tunes student models with importance weighting to explicitly follow these styles, improving Pass@k over standard fine-tuning across six math reasoning benchmarks.
